[B1] < deviceB | 'key' : Kdevice , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Kdevice , ... > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (deviceB ; Kdevice) .
[B1] < UserX | 'keys' : Keys , ... > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (deviceB ; Kdevice)
=> < UserX | 'keys' : (Kdevice , Keys) , ... > .
[B2] < deviceB | 'key' : Kdevice , ... > $ UserX 'bindDevice' deviceB | Kuser
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Kdevice , ... > $ deviceB 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Kdevice ; Kuser) .
[B2] < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ... > $ deviceB 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Kdevice ; Kuser)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : UserY , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ... > .
[B3] < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Kdevice ; Kuser)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : UserY , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
